E1.meaning: share of flagged weaknesses that are real hidden traits / share of hidden traits flagged, on unseen seasons with random trait kinds

E2.meaning: noise of the Monte Carlo estimate only, not validity of the model

E3.meaning: a plan counts if one lever targets a real hidden trait; the baseline is the share of all lever combinations that would also count

E4.meaning: digits outside {claim.field} placeholders are rejected by code (0 by construction)

duel_interaction.meaning: how often a bench's best half-time answer depends on what the other bench does (true matrix); plan target: at least half

E7.meaning: how much the analyst anticipated the other bench (higher is better)

E8.meaning: xPts lost vs the best response to what the other bench really did, in our simulator

eval.scope: all results are inside our simulator; synthetic data; not claims about real football

adaptation_detector.rule: smallest z with online false-alarm rate <= 5% per team-match at min_change 0.2

sim_shots.rule: grid value with mean shots per match closest to the middle of the target range

eval.story_criteria: a build-up switch is detected live and matches a real lever change (the change happened before the detection and the estimated change minute is within 10 minutes of it); first-half goal difference <= 2; the true matrix has no dominant option for at least one bench; at least one bench has a regret whose paired 90% interval is above zero; final goal difference <= 2; total goals between 1 and 6
